description: Per-domain contribution corpus for TensorGuard. Each entry is a minimal nn.Module exercising exactly one verification domain. The goal (100_STEPS.md Step 3) is to show that every VERIFICATION domain demonstrably contributes at least one bug that the base shape (L1) view misses, and to document any domain that never contributes as DIAGNOSTIC-ONLY.
